purpose: Synthetic near-limit IEEE-33 AC-feasibility diagnostic. It is designed to exercise AC repair with controller-reachable station demand; it is not a measured Caltech feeder model or a field-capacity claim.

charging_data.station_assignment: deterministic hash of session ID across synthetic stations
charging_data.note: Real ACN sessions are mapped to synthetic feeder stations; this is an explicit experiment assumption.

solar_data.note: Approximate Caltech/Pasadena location selected to align solar resource with Caltech sessions.

pv_proxy_sensitivity.note: PVWatts GHI proxy for controlled sensitivity experiments; it is not measured Caltech PV production.

feeder_sensitivity.note: High shared-capacity setting used only to permit simultaneous station demand. AC feasibility, not feeder-cap scarcity, is the limiting mechanism in this diagnostic.

grid_sensitivity.note: The IEEE-33 base state remains safe (about 0.95085 p.u.), while reachable simultaneous 28.8 kW station loads can cross 0.95 p.u. This is a controlled repair-activation sensitivity, not a site calibration.
